Convert a URL into a QR Code

Turning a website link into a QR code lets people open your page just by scanning it with a phone camera — no typing, no mistyped URLs. It's the fastest way to bridge print and digital, whether that's a flyer, a product label, or a business card.

When a URL QR code makes sense

  • Directing people from a printed flyer or poster to your website
  • Linking a product package to a landing page or manual
  • Sharing a link on a slide or screen where typing isn't practical
  • Putting a portfolio or booking link on a business card

Tips for a reliable URL QR code

  • Use the full URL including https://
  • Prefer a short, stable link so the code stays valid long-term
  • Test the code with a real phone camera before printing at scale
  • Leave quiet white space around the code so scanners can find it
